dedupe_keys.name: oredp irish tidal resource potential zones national ireland northern ireland and 0 5 5 10 and 10 15 km coastal bands marine institute

description: The Marine Institute publishes on the Irish open data portal the tidal resource potential zones reported in the Offshore Renewable Energy Development Plan (OREDP) of the Irish energy department. The series has five datasets: the Irish tidal resource potential zone, the zone between Ireland and Northern Ireland, and the potential within 0 to 5 km, 5 to 10 km and 10 to 15 km of the coastline; the catalogue also lists the OREDP study and assessment areas. Each dataset is offered as zipped CSV, shapefile and KML files from the Marine Institute atlas server, available for free download under CC BY 4.0. The datasets were issued on 6 February 2018 and their catalogue entries were refreshed on 25 September 2026 through the national spatial data harvest. Coverage is Irish waters, including the cross-border zone with Northern Ireland. Caveats: the portal descriptions are one line each, so the method, resource units and thresholds must be taken from the OREDP itself, and the zones reflect the plan assessment, not site surveys. Simulation uses are candidate tidal energy areas by distance to shore for offshore renewable capacity planning and grid connection studies. Related records: data-hydropot-integral-swiss-river-network covers hydro potential elsewhere.
